name: SOL spot-confirmed favourite, maker entry
description: sol-zfav's signal (SOL spot at least 1.5 sigma past the strike) traded as a maker: a post-only order one tick inside the spread on the favourite's side between 420 s and 150 s to close, re-priced every 30 s, held to settlement.
hypothesis: sol-zfav's taker rule nets about -0.5c on Jun-Sep development data (4,037 trades; May -1.0, Jun -0.7, Jul -1.0, Aug +0.4, Sep -0.5): the confirmed favourite is worth roughly +1..3c but the taker fee (about 0.6c at 90c) and half the spread (0.5-1c) consume it. A maker pays no fee and earns the spread; the seller who hits a bid on a spot-confirmed favourite is mostly a nervous holder. Wrong if backfill-engine fills are adversely selected as in every earlier maker test (sol-spreadmk, dog-seller, volfav-maker: -0.5..-1.1c), or the fill count is too low for a CI.
